questions.query: What is the difference between “AI for Security” and “Security for AI”?
questions.reference_answer: “AI for Security” is using AI technologies to solve security problems, or building AI into security products. “Security for AI” is designing and implementing security measures to protect AI technologies and infrastructure, which matters most when the AI is critical to business or nation-state infrastructure.
